planets.name: TOI-1749 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1749 with a 9.04-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1749 d was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-1749. Its orbit and size follow Fukui et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
